description: Seamless-looking RPG ground tile, full canvas packed with a mature deciduous forest's spring MOSS AND LOW GRASS viewed from above, purely 16-bit pixel art. This is an unlit material swatch for a 512-pixel-wide scene, no sky, no objects and NO composition of a landscape. Three to six restrained colors, medium green base, dark jade recesses, cool sage-green blade tips. Read as a sea of moss with irregular interleaved clusters of low grass blades, leaf-shaped connected dashes, broken curved runs and pockets of quiet flat turf. Plenty of medium-colored base, small marks 2-6 native pixels, no speckle/no scattered one-pixel grain, no white highlights; think exquisite old-school Japanese console RPG woodland tiles at their native size. Intricate organic clumps but simple readable marks with striped or comb-shaped tips in irregular places. Edges entirely covered with grass, top-down flat ground only, no trees, twigs, flowers, boulders, path, horizon, water, cast shadows, 3D rendering, photo or UI. Flat opaque image.
